name: mac-app-packaged-identity
goal: The packaged Harness.app reports isPackaged so the bundled Tracker self-install runs, and nothing in the bundle is group or world writable; a packaged-app test proves both

evidence: Installed app (release 138w2r) runs Contents/MacOS/Electron: Electron app.isPackaged is false for an executable named electron, so initializeTrackerBundle returns early. Helpers/harness and the copied playwright-core are mode 0777.

tracker-bundle.test and package-mac-tracker.test call installBundledTracker directly with a fake or partial bundle; nothing launched an assembled app, so the isPackaged guard and bundle modes were never exercised. New package-mac-app.test.ts assembles with the real packager and launches it.
